blocks.raw: > Delivers streaming video and a quality viewing experience anywhere by adapting real-time to available bandwidth. To meet consumer expectations in a hyperconnected world, content providers need a high-performance streaming media delivery solution like Akamai’s Adaptive Media Delivery. Optimized for Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) streaming, it provides a high-quality viewing experience across the broad variety of network types, fixed or mobile, at varying connection speeds. Because it’s built on the Akamai Intelligent Platform, Adaptive Media Delivery provides superior scalability, reliability, and availability.
